content:
Maria: heads up — main pipeline went red immediately after my merge (PR #4821). CI: https://ci.redwood/console/2087654321/builds/1123 :frowning:
CI Bot: Build failed on job `integration-gpu-shard-4` — failing test: `tests/integration/test_kv_cache.py::test_eviction_timeout`. Log: https://ci.redwood/console/2087654321/builds/1123/logs
Oliver: who owns that test/shard? @Kevin?
Kevin: I touched kv cache in that PR (autoscaler batching change). I didn't see this locally. i'll look now, oncall pinged.
Sree: oncall here. Kicking off a rerun: `ci rerun 1123 --shard=4`
CI Bot: Rerun started by Sree — job `1123-rerun-1` (watch: https://ci.redwood/runs/1123-rerun-1)
Maria: if rerun flakes again we should be ready to bisect or revert; that merge bundled a couple of commits.
Oliver: can someone paste the failing stacktrace?
CI Bot: <<<snippet>>>
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory when allocating tensor with shape [2048, 4096] (requested 67.1 MiB)
  File "/workspace/runtime/inference/kernel.cu", line 142, in run_kernel
  File "/workspace/serve/cache/kv_cache.py", line 311, in append_kv
<<<end snippet>>>
Kevin: that looks like allocation growth tied to batch depth + KV retention. autoscaler change increased default batch depth. i'll try to reproduce: `pytest tests/integration/test_kv_cache.py::test_eviction_timeout -k local --runslow`
Jason: if rerun fails and Kevin can't repro quickly, prepare a revert PR. We need the main pipeline green for the afternoon deploy. @Maria can you check queue/throughput metrics?
Maria: queue length spiked right after merge — 0.8 -> 2.3 average concurrency in the 5m window. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/xy123/job-queue?var-job=integration-gpu-shard-4
Sree: rerun finished — still red, same OOM.
Oliver: assigning ownership to Kevin for now. If you need help bisecting, ping me.
Kevin: reproducing locally now. If I can't get a quick fix i'll open a revert in the next 10m.
CI Bot: New PR 4830 created by Kevin: "Revert 'autoscaler: increase batch depth'" — https://git.redwood/pulls/4830
Maria: thanks. @Jason watch the release dashboard. If revert CI looks good we can fast-merge and unblock deploy.
CI Bot: CI for PR 4830 passed on all shards ✅
Oliver: great — merging revert now. :thumbsup:
Kevin: thanks everyone. i'll follow up with a proper fix and add a regression test that simulates increased batch depth + long KV retention.
Maria: appreciated. let's keep an eye on the staging run for the next hour.
